Interface EventVisitor<S extends Screen<S>>

Type Parameters:
S - the concrete screen type returned after handling the event
All Known Implementing Classes:
ConnectingScreen, ConnectingScreen, DisconnectedScreen, DisconnectedScreen, EndGameScreen, EndGameScreen, ExitScreen, ExitScreen, GameScreen, GameScreen, GUIScreen, HomeScreen, HomeScreen, LobbyScreen, LobbyScreen, LoginScreen, LoginScreen, Screen, TotemPickingScreen, TotemPickingScreen, TUIScreen
public interface EventVisitor<S extends Screen<S>>
Visitor interface for dispatching ServerEvent subtypes to the correct view handler without instanceof checks. Implemented by both TUIScreen and GUIScreen base classes.
